rows.text: [FIXTURE] The opening verse begins with the blessed name of Allah, combining His attributes of universal mercy (ar-Rahman) and specific mercy for the believers (ar-Raheem).
[FIXTURE] All praise belongs to Allah alone as Lord and Sustainer of every world and every creature within it.
[FIXTURE] A repetition emphasizing that mercy is the defining quality of how Allah deals with His creation.
[FIXTURE] Sovereignty over the Day of Judgement is affirmed exclusively for Allah, when no other authority avails.
[FIXTURE] Worship and the seeking of aid are directed to Allah alone, the foundation of sincere devotion (ikhlas).
[FIXTURE] A supplication asking to be kept firm upon the straight, balanced path.
[FIXTURE] The path of those favored, distinguished from the path of those who earned anger or who went astray.
